skill.name: azure-resource-lookup
skill.description: Find Azure resources across subscriptions and resource groups using Azure Resource Graph. It helps list resource types, inspect tags, identify orphaned assets, and prepare scoped read-only queries.
skill.summary: Find and summarize Azure resources with read-only Azure Resource Graph queries.
skill.author: microsoft

content.value_statement: Cloud teams often need a fast inventory of Azure resources across many subscriptions. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through read-only Azure Resource Graph lookups.
actual_capabilities: Routes resource inventory requests to Azure Resource Graph when dedicated MCP tools do not cover the resource type.
Helps list Azure resources by subscription, resource group, type, tag, location, and health state.
Provides query patterns for orphaned disks, unused public IP addresses, idle load balancers, and missing tags.
Guides use of Azure CLI table output and JMESPath shaping for readable results.
Recommends dedicated MCP tools first when they provide complete coverage for a requested resource type.
Documents common error causes, including missing extensions, RBAC limits, invalid KQL, and empty scopes.
limitations: It performs read-only discovery and does not deploy, modify, or delete Azure resources.
It depends on Azure credentials and Reader access for the requested subscriptions.
Azure Resource Graph data can lag and should not be used for real-time monitoring.
It does not provide cost analysis or non-Azure cloud inventory.

use_cases.title: Inventory App Services and Virtual Machines
use_cases.description: List matching resources across subscriptions before migration, cleanup, or maintenance work.

use_cases.title: Find Missing Tags and Orphaned Assets
use_cases.description: Discover resources that need ownership tags or cleanup review across cloud environments.

use_cases.title: Investigate Failed or Unhealthy Resources
use_cases.description: Locate resources with failed provisioning states or health issues before deeper troubleshooting.

prompt_templates.title: List Web Apps
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Azure web apps across all available subscriptions. Show name, resource group, location, and state.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Required Tags
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Azure resources in the production resource group that are missing Environment or CostCenter tags. Summarize by type.

prompt_templates.title: Find Orphaned Network Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify unattached managed disks, unused public IP addresses, and network interfaces not attached to virtual machines. Limit results per subscription.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Cross-Subscription Inventory
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an Azure Resource Graph plan for a cross-subscription inventory. Include scope, columns, result limits, and fallback MCP tools.

output_examples.input: List all App Services in my subscription.
output: Shows web app names, kind, resource group, location, state, and service plan.
Notes that App Service list requests use Azure Resource Graph when no dedicated list tool is available.

output_examples.input: Find orphaned resources that may need cleanup.
output: Groups unattached disks, unused public IP addresses, orphaned network interfaces, and idle load balancers.
Includes subscription and resource group context for follow-up review.

output_examples.input: Show resources missing required governance tags.
output: Summarizes resources missing Environment or CostCenter tags by type and resource group.
Keeps the result read-only and suitable for governance review.

best_practices: Start with a narrow subscription or resource group scope before broad tenant inventory.
Use result limits when exploring large tenants.
Prefer dedicated MCP tools when they fully support the requested resource type.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to change Azure resources or run mutation commands.
Do not use stale Resource Graph results for incident monitoring.
Do not request broad tenant inventory when a subscription or resource group is known.

faq.question: Does this skill change Azure resources?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for read-only discovery with Azure Resource Graph and supporting MCP tools.

faq.question: Does it work without Azure access?
faq.answer: No. The user needs Azure credentials and permission to read the requested subscriptions or resource groups.

faq.question: Can it list App Services?
faq.answer: Yes. It routes App Service and web app list requests through Azure Resource Graph when needed.

faq.question: Can it find orphaned resources?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for unattached disks, unused public IP addresses, idle load balancers, and orphaned interfaces.

faq.question: Is it for cost optimization?
faq.answer: No. It can surface inventory signals, but cost analysis should use a dedicated cost workflow.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code according to the report metadata.
